So not long ago a friend and I had a big night out, so we decided to go into the nearest shopping center and grab some good old McDonald's before our hangovers took a turn for the worst. As a side note, (this is key to later on in the story), the McDonald's is down two flights of stairs from where we currently were. As we were starting to walk down the stairs (we were both taking it slow because our heads hurt) we noticed a young whale some way away from the ocean. We called this whale lollies. Now the reason for her name is we didn't actually see her, first. We heard her resonating mating call, much to the irritation of my friend and I. "LOLLIES" screeched the whale as it launched its unstoppable mass at incredible velocities towards the lolly store adjacent to the stairs. Both my friend and i nearly break down in tears from laughter after this rare whale sighting; however that wasn't the end.

Post our seemingly short trip down the stairs we talked at the bottom of the stairwell for 5 minutes before approaching the McDonalds. As we approached the glorious grease merchant the ground began to shake. The earth was rumbling at our feet until finally a quiet ding noise paused the madness. Two metal doors opened 40 meters away from us, revealing this story's protagonist, our favorite whale, LOLLIES!! Now at this point my friend and I are already in line for McDonalds and he looks at me and says, "it would be so funny if she came over...." His sentence was interrupted by the thud thud thud of a whale charging. charging... right in our direction! We were now playing a giant game of bowling and with a ball larger then all the pins combined she was guaranteed a strike. Luckily for us we managed to move our weary heads away from the phenomenal force charging straight to the front of the line.

Having survived almost certain death, I was just glad to have survived and wasn't concerned with her act of defiance to public waiting lines (which is one of my biggest pet peeves). After having ordered my hash brown and burger my friend and i sat down just in time to notice the fupanova collect her order. She walked out with two giant paper bags filled with food, sadly i couldn't find out the bag's contents but my goodness they were loaded.

TLDR; Fat girl goes to lolly shop. takes elevator down flights of stairs to MacDonald. Cuts line. Leaves with arms filled with grease bags.

[META] How do we decide when something becomes science?

So far, to be accepted as science, a post should:

  • not have its top comment as an objection (for eg:1+1+1=1).

  • CLAIMs starts off unproven : it doesn't have to quote established science. If it doesn't, LINKs can show that a claim is in accord with established science. Until then, it is a CLAIM.

  • BUILDs become PROOF if they are uncountered, and become SCIENCE if they are in turn built upon.

  • LINKs cannot become SCIENCE. They serve only to support CLAIMs, or show a link between PROOF and CLAIM or CLAIM and CLAIM.

Why the different flairs you ask? Imagine this scenario :

let's say post 1+1=3 is post A. Someone builds upon it : post B1. It's in turn built (B2) and built (B3) and built.... finally arrving to SCIENCE B10.

In parallel, a CLAIM (let's call it C1) appears, which is linked to B4 and B5, and therefore also becomes SCIENCE. It builds and builds and builds up until C10.

Now someone points out that B10 and C10 are contradictory (CRISIS). How do we know which one is "more correct"? By knowing that one (in this case, B10) has a more direct link to the root science, in this case 1+1=3, because it was built upon it, rather than claimed and later linked to the knowledge tree.

The flairs allow for a quicker evaluation of the consistency of the argument.
